abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Brostamide reduces side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Alvenor reduces side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Brostamide reduces side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Alvenor reduces side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. All data for this comparison were collected at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 2. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.
